summary: Family seal maker (140 staff, EUR 35 M); we are 0.82 % of its turnover, spend up 31 %. Allocating volumes; pricing committee above 2 %; standard items not discounted, only multi-year volume agreements change prices. Thin margin on the 32 mm seal (price only 8.1 % over should-cost of its plant). Its lip seal is 10.6 % dearer than Hermannsdorfer's. Open moderate; trade multi-year volume, cite the rival lip-seal price.
notes: Wants multi-year volume agreements; fears losing lip-seal share, especially if our kit goes to sup:70430. Do not cite Ravensteiner's 32 mm price: it is higher (38.29 vs 37.55). Allocation news but no own words on capacity. OTD sliding to 75.5 %, two open 8D. Payment record fine.
fears: losing lip-seal share if our kit goes to sup:70430
